purpose: Indexes YouTube search results for seed terms to build a candidates dataset. Runs yt-dlp flat-mode searches on configured terms grouped by substream, deduplicates videos by ID while tracking cross-family provenance, enriches missing metadata fields (channel, duration, upload_date) via per-video pulls, applies three screening filters (doubles detection, duration band, upload date), and writes a fixed-column candidates.csv with keep and triage_verdict fields left blank for later stages.

public_api.name: search_term_rows(term, substream)
public_api.role: Run flat metadata index for one search term; return list of row dicts per hit, stamped with search_term and substream. Called once per seed term.

public_api.name: enrich_row(row)
public_api.role: Fill empty channel/duration_s/upload_date fields via per-video --dump-json pull (mutates row in place); return True only if a metadata call actually hit YouTube to pace real requests.

public_api.name: flag_doubles(title)
public_api.role: Detect if title looks like a doubles match using case-insensitive substring phrases and whole-token abbreviations; used to flag (not drop) likely doubles videos.

public_api.name: duration_out_of_band(duration_s, substream)
public_api.role: Check if a known duration sits outside the sane match-length band; instructional substream skips the short-duration check since coach clips run short by design.

public_api.name: upload_before_floor(upload_date)
public_api.role: Check if upload predates the configured floor date (YYYYMMDD); returns False by default when floor is unset, so this screen is opt-in.

public_api.name: build_candidates(search_terms)
public_api.role: Main pipeline: index all search families, deduplicate by video_id, enrich metadata, apply three screens (doubles, duration, upload date), write candidates.csv, return rows.

public_api.name: main()
public_api.role: Entry point; parse arguments and call build_candidates().
